purpose: Adapters for nineteenth-century Brady and Parker slide collections with catalogue, remounting, reference-set, and acquisition evidence.
guards: Track original slide number and later new-slide number separately where specimens were remounted.
Distributed reference sets in Vienna and London are distinct physical holdings even when derived from the same Challenger material.
Preserve original arrival boxes and current rehousing as different physical states.

adapters.institution_scope: Great North Museum Hancock George Stewardson Brady collections
adapters.target: peer-reviewed catalogue study manuscript notebook and subsequent museum catalogue discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract slide number taxon locality collector publication type status loan and remounting fields; model specimens moving from original to new slides as explicit events and isolate pre-1900 records.

adapters.target: official collection page plus peer-reviewed historical type/reference-slide study
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat the 435-slide 1887 gift as a bounded reference set and capture accession/type/station metadata without merging it into London Brady holdings.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London Micropalaeontology Collection
adapters.target: 2026 peer-reviewed NHM collection history plus Data Portal and legacy registers
adapters.promotion_rule: Use acquisition chronology to split Carpenter Brady Parker and later collections; follow Data Portal/register identifiers without inferring counts from department aggregates.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London W.K. Parker Foraminifera Collection
adapters.target: 1992 museum catalogue handwritten T.R. Jones catalogue and current collection history
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract slide/catalogue/locality/publication relations and record purchase curation cost original wooden boxes and later rehousing as separate acquisition/curation/material-state events.
